verdict.rationale: Ardent is a Postgres database-branching service with a CLI and API that coding agents consume; it is not itself an agent or host that runs tools. Acting as an MCP client is therefore outside its product category, and nothing in the evidence shows it ships any MCP-client capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
